$comment: Consolidated cover sheet for all ten Declarative Watch Face Format (<WatchFace>) samples in android/wear-os-samples. No `module` because the import renders all ten watch-face modules via `patches/0001-root-build.patch`, each with a distinct `res/raw/wff_*.xml` / `res/raw/wfp_*.xml` stem.
title: Wear OS Watch Faces

components.caption: Analog watch face with five customizable complication slots (SHORT_TEXT, RANGED_VALUE, MONOCHROMATIC_IMAGE, SMALL_IMAGE, GOAL_PROGRESS, WEIGHTED_ELEMENTS) and a color style configuration.
Preset-flavor watch face combining four complication slots with four user configurations and three curated style flavors.
Digital watch face with a masked background photo user configuration.
Digital watch face with a multi-photo background user configuration.
Minimal analog watch face with hour, minute, and second hands and a color style configuration.
Minimal digital watch face with clean typography and ambient mode.
Watch Face Format v2 weather watch face driven by [WEATHER.*] data bindings.
Default marketplace watch face from the WatchFacePush sample.
Firefly watch face from the WatchFacePush sample.
River watch face from the WatchFacePush sample.
